title: Library Management System (LMS)
description: A full-stack web application replicating my college's library system, allowing students to register, search, borrow, and return books online, while administrators manage inventory, users, and overdue records. As the team lead, I coordinated a 4-member team, handled both front-end and back-end development, designed MongoDB schemas, implemented role-based access control, and ensured timely project delivery. Successfully deployed as a working prototype with positive feedback from professors.
roles_and_achievements: Led a 4-member team and coordinated weekly meetings with professors
Designed and implemented RESTful APIs for books, users, and transactions
Developed MongoDB schemas using Mongoose
Integrated Redux for state management
Implemented JWT authentication with role-based access
Successfully delivered a functional prototype for the college library
Received positive feedback from faculty for replicating real-world workflows
Enhanced leadership and full-stack development skills

title: TA Management System
description: A full-stack system that streamlines university TA workflows: applicants create profiles and submit résumés, instructors post/manage courses and review candidates, and the TA Committee selects final TAs. Built as a monorepo (React + Redux frontend, Node/Express + MongoDB backend) with file uploads, notifications, and role-based views for Applicants, Instructors, and the TA Committee.
roles_and_achievements: Designed core entities and flows across Applicants, Courses, Applications, and Messages
Implemented résumé uploads via multer with secure static serving from /files
Built REST APIs for users, courses, applications, and notifications (Express + Mongoose)
Structured React app by role (Applicant, Instructor, Committee) with Redux state management
Added instructor messaging/notifications and committee TA selection (ta_selected)
Set up local dev workflow with nodemon, concurrently, and CRA proxy to the API
Documented .env configuration and recommended replacing hardcoded Mongo URI with process.env.MONGO_URI
Improved developer experience with axios action creators, reducers, and a centralized store

title: Appointment Booking System
description: A full-stack scheduling platform where customers book time slots with approved service providers. Backend is production-ready with Spring Boot (JWT auth, DTO-based responses, layered architecture); React frontend with Redux Toolkit and Tailwind is in active development.
roles_and_achievements: Designed domain models and DB schema for Users/Roles, Providers, Appointments, and BusinessCategory
Implemented admin approval workflow so only verified providers are visible to customers
Built JWT-based authentication and authorization with role-based access (ADMIN, PROVIDER, CUSTOMER)
Developed booking lifecycle APIs: create, edit, cancel, and list appointments
Standardized responses using DTOs and a ResponseMapper utility for consistent API contracts
Added enum-driven provider categories and provider profile fields (e.g., agencyImageUrl) for discoverability
Structured Spring Boot backend into controller/service/repository layers with clear separation of concerns
Prepared React frontend scaffold with Redux Toolkit, React Router, Axios, and Tailwind for responsive UI

title: EmotionSense AI
description: A multimodal deep learning application that detects human emotions from voice recordings and their text transcriptions. The backend (Flask) serves a TensorFlow/Keras model with Whisper-based transcripts, while a lightweight HTML/CSS/JS frontend animates results with dynamic emojis and background changes for an engaging UX.
roles_and_achievements: Designed the end-to-end multimodal pipeline combining audio features with text transcripts for emotion prediction
Integrated OpenAI Whisper to transcribe uploaded .wav files and feed the text branch of the model
Implemented Flask APIs for upload/inference and structured model loading with reusable preprocessing utilities
Persisted preprocessing artifacts (e.g., audio scaler via Joblib) to ensure consistent inference
Built a minimal, fast frontend with real-time typing animation, emoji feedback, and dynamic background by emotion
Authored clear setup/run docs and requirements to enable quick local runs and reproducibility
Organized the repository with clean separation of templates/static, model assets, and data for maintainability
Prepared the app for production serving with Gunicorn-compatible entry points

title: WeatherApp
description: A lightweight React application that fetches and displays current weather by city using the OpenWeather API. Shows temperature, humidity, wind speed, and conditions with a responsive UI for desktop and mobile. Deployed for public access.
roles_and_achievements: Implemented city-based search and current weather retrieval with OpenWeather API
Displayed key metrics (temperature, humidity, wind speed, description) in a clean, responsive layout
Configured environment-based API key management via Vite (.env) for safer local development
Built with TypeScript for stronger typing and fewer runtime errors
Deployed a production build to Render and validated live functionality across devices
Set up version control and project workflows with Git and GitHub
